# Garage sale notes

Planning a garage sale for next month to clear out the stuff that came off the bike frame and the
old NAS that's getting decommissioned once the Proxmox migration finishes.

## Pricing

Pricing low on purpose — the goal is an empty garage by Sunday evening, not maximizing revenue on a
box of old cables and a bike wheel that's slightly out of true.

## Signage

Need to make signs with an arrow pointing from the main road, since the street is easy to miss and
the last sale a neighbor ran had almost no walk-up traffic until someone finally put up a sign at
the corner.
